short: Speech Eat Learn provides pediatric speech therapy in Boca Raton, helping children develop functional communication skills through individualized care. Services include language therapy, feeding support, and AAC, with mobile appointments across designated South Florida communities.
certs: Certificate of Clinical Competence in Speech-Language Pathology (CCC-SLP), American Speech-Language-Hearing Association (ASHA); Florida Licensed Speech-Language Pathologist
training: Master of Science in Speech-Language Pathology, University of St. Augustine for Health Sciences (2020); undergraduate education at Florida Atlantic University
pricing: $50-$350, Cash, Credit Card, Zelle, Apple Pay, Paypal, Step Up Scholarship, CDC+
long:
A child's ability to communicate influences how they learn, build relationships, express emotions, and participate in everyday activities. When speech sounds are unclear, language development is delayed, or communication becomes frustrating, individualized support can help families understand the next steps. Pediatric speech therapy in Boca Raton focuses on identifying each child's communication strengths and providing practical strategies that support meaningful progress at home, school, and beyond. 

Families exploring pediatric speech therapy in Boca Raton can access individualized services addressing speech clarity, vocabulary development, language comprehension, and everyday communication.

Speech Eat Learn offers pediatric speech-language services throughout Boca Raton and surrounding South Florida communities. Founded by Karina Lee, a licensed speech-language pathologist, the practice emphasizes individualized treatment based on each child's abilities, interests, and developmental priorities.
